integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, cel shaded with flat colors and thick black inked outlines, a near-monochrome palette of charcoal and slate greys on a plain pure-white background, with only the off-white horns and the pale beige stitches breaking the grey. The tall, thin demon girl shown in <Picture 1> stands in the same full-body three-quarter framing, preserving her dark grey speckled skin crossed by rows of beige stitched seams and faint pinkish-brown scars on her torso, arms, and legs, her floor-length straight black hair with blunt bangs covering one eye, the single white pupil glowing in her black eye, her pointed ears, the pair of curved off-white horns with the small grey bow, her long clawed fingers, and her clawed bare feet. She shifts her weight onto her left foot and begins to walk forward toward the lower left of the frame with slow, steady, slightly hunched steps, each clawed foot lifting and planting flat on the white floor. Her long arms hang loosely at her sides and swing a little with each step, her thin clawed fingers dangling and twitching. Her very long hair sways behind her and drags across the floor in heavy black strands, the thin stray threads around it trailing and swinging with the motion. Her head stays lowered and steady while her horns bob gently with each footfall, and her single white pupil stays fixed ahead. The camera tracks with her at slow speed, keeping her full body centered in frame from horns to feet throughout, so the plain white background and the soft grey contact shadow under her feet stay constant while she keeps walking at an even pace for the whole shot.

overall_soundscape: A quiet, empty room tone. Soft bare footsteps land at an even, slow rhythm, each with a faint click of claws on a hard floor, accompanied by the continuous soft hiss of long hair dragging along the ground.
